options.content:
| Code | Status | Meaning |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **200** | 🟢 OK | Success |
| **302** | 🔵 Found | Temporary redirect |
| **304** | 🔵 Not Modified | Loaded from Cache |
| **400** | 🟠 Bad Request | Malformed syntax / Validation error |
| **401** | 🟠 Unauthorized | Invalid or missing API key |
| **403** | 🟠 Forbidden | Valid auth, but permissions denied |
| **404** | 🟠 Not Found | Resource does not exist |
| **499** | 🔴 Client Closed | Browser canceled request early |
| **502** | 🔴 Bad Gateway | Upstream server is down/unreachable |

targets.expr: {service_name="traefik",host_name="$host"} | RequestProtocol=~".+" | DownstreamStatus!="200" | DownstreamStatus!="0" | DownstreamStatus!="" | line_format "Status: {{.DownstreamStatus}} Client {{.ClientHost}} {{.RequestMethod}} {{.RequestAddr}}{{.RequestPath}} -> {{.ServiceAddr}}"
